title: Design: Classification with no matching work order shows an empty list
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin (a user with every setting, See Financial Data included).
  • Use a desktop browser window 1440 pixels wide at 100% zoom.
  • Have Internal Work Orders turned on in Settings > Work Orders.
  • Have no internal work order at this location.
  • Open the attached picture iwo-flow4-03-03-list-no-charge-no-results.png at 100% zoom beside the screen.
custom_steps:
1. Open Work Orders.
  2. Pick Internal in the Classification chip.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • Every row is listed.

Step 2:

  • The chip reads "Classification: Internal" in blue on a light blue chip.
  • No rows show, and the list shows the text-only message "No work orders match these filters" with "Try removing a filter to widen your results." under it.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Internal Work Orders (PRD)", Confluence 942243841, version 1.0 final (9 Nov 2026, Milos Vasic), read 12 Nov 2026 · Epic SV-11665, story SV-11759 (Story 2, An internal or no-charge work order from creation to Close)

  • S2-R14: “While the Internal Work Orders setting is on, the work orders list shows a chip "Classification: All / Billable / Internal / No Charge" (the existing single-choice chip), default All, on every tab and in the mobile filter sheet. While the setting is off the chip is not shown; the badges on the rows stay.”

The build is not yet available to check this case against.
